---
title: test
---


```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| label: data
N <- 10000
data <-
  tibble(
    size = 1000 * rpois(N, 1),
    relative_complexity = rnorm(N, 0, 1)) %>%
  mutate(
    net_benefit = rnorm(N, 1 + size/100 + 0.5 * relative_complexity, 2),
    measure_complexity = rbinom(N, size = 4, plogis(relative_complexity)),
    should_disclose = ifelse(net_benefit > 0, 1, 0),
    small = ifelse(size < 50, 1, 0)
  )
```


```{r}
hist(data$size)
ggplot(data, aes(x = relative_complexity, y = net_benefit)) +
  geom_point()
```

```{r}
data %>%
  group_by(measure_complexity) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(should_disclose),
            N = n())
```
